text:
katie (finance): Heads-up: rolling out a small change to how startup credits and minor overages are handled. Goal: simpler expirations + a short automatic grace window so developers don't get surprised by one-off bursts. Full doc here: https://redwood.internal/docs/billing/credits-and-grace (internal)
ops-bot: Scheduled email to customers in the 0-2k monthly tier queued for 2026-04-01 15:00 UTC. Template: Billing -> credit-harmonization-v1
jonathan (eng): Quick q — does the 72h grace apply to Hosted free-tier only or also to Dedicated/reserved customers?
emily (billing): It applies to Hosted accounts and Starter/Demo reserved pockets. Dedicated annual contracts are unchanged by default; account teams can opt customers into the harmonized expiry if they request it.
sara (support): For clarity — what exactly changes about startup credits expiry?
katie (finance): Two pieces:
1) Harmonize all promotional startup credits to a single 12-month expiry from grant date (was a mix of 6/9/12). Existing credits will be normalized on 2026-05-01; customers will see a single "expires" date in invoices.
2) Add a 72-hour soft grace window for minor overages under $5 for Hosted tiers so accidental spikes don't generate urgent invoices. Grace window auto-clears or converts to a billed adjustment after 72h if total usage remains above threshold.
mike (sales): Will there be an SLA-level exemption for customers on negotiated monthly minimums? Some of our mid-market accounts rely on predictable metering.
emily (billing): Yes — negotiated accounts (listed on billing profiles) continue to use their contract terms. The harmonization only affects non-negotiated promotional credits and the default Hosted plan behavior.
jonathan (eng): Any runtime-side changes we need to be aware of? e.g., rate-limit headers or new invoice metadata fields for the grace window?
katie (finance): We'll add two invoice line items / metadata keys: "harmonized_promo_expires" (ISO date) and "grace_window_applied" (true/false). No runtime traffic change. Example invoice snippet:
```
line_item: promotional_credit
amount: -20.00
harmonized_promo_expires: 2027-03-15

line_item: usage_overage
amount: 3.45
grace_window_applied: true
```
ops-bot: Reminder: rollout phase 1 -> internal docs + UI flags on 2026-04-01; phase 2 -> normalize existing credits on 2026-05-01.
sara (support): Can we get a short QA doc for support with canned responses? Customers will ping about "why did my credit expire?"
katie (finance): Yep — I'll drop a support playbook into #support-playbooks by EOD today. It will include customer-facing language and refund/adjustment guidance.
mike (sales): Heads-up to account teams: please review any accounts that had bespoke promo expiries — we'll postpone normalization for accounts flagged in the "hold-harmonize" list.
emily (billing): Implementation note for eng: the new invoice fields are string typed. If you need a feature flag key to gate behavior, use `billing.harmonize.startup_credit`.
jonathan (eng): Thanks. We'll add parsing and ensure dashboard shows the new expiry field in the billing UI. Will notify once PR is merged.
katie (finance): Thanks everyone. If there are no blockers we'll publish the external FAQ tomorrow morning. :tada:
